<!-- pr-reviewer: 90014d6223e81c459a73011f7cff147f66f844a6 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The change affects stock simulation, geometry, and fixture collision checks.
I found no blocking defect.

The retained cuts preserve wall positions and separate material intervals through turns, clips, and later cuts.
The entry snapshot keeps the cut-through gouge check active.
The refusal tests cover non-finite input and the work limits.
The moved ball atom and verdict merge function are unchanged.
Issue #1805 records why the field engine keeps its named refusal.

I tested the trial merge locally on Linux.
The PR head was `90014d6223e81c459a73011f7cff147f66f844a6`.
The upstream main was `d1484f02a359eb496803630f36575897a88f75ee`.
The trial merge had no conflicts.
No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Build and tests for camcraft-sim: lib and 36 integration suites | 429 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored |
| Build and tests for camcraft-app: lib and 19 integration suites | 431 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run` | Passed; targeted suites ran separately |

The uncommitted trial merge made the gate plan include unrelated changes from main.
The local commands therefore selected the affected sim and app suites directly.
All 40 new tests passed, including the six internal tests in `carry_history`.
Seven heavy tests remained ignored. The full release gate, Windows, and macOS were not tested.

I reran two mutations from the PR's test plan myself.
Both mutations compiled and failed at runtime. Both tests passed after byte-for-byte source restoration.

| Mutation | Test | Mutated / restored |
|---|---|---|
| Replace `cut.rs` with the upstream version | `a_contoured_wall_keeps_its_off_grid_position_after_a_side_turn` | Red / green |
| Disable the entry snapshot read in `carry_exact.rs` | `a_cut_through_after_the_side_turn_still_convicts_the_part` | Red / green |

The first mutation reported `turned wall is 6.5; expected 6.2 within 0.01`.
The second reported `an emptied column cannot acquit the part`.

No golden files changed. There are no moved NC or CL goldens to check.
No UI files changed, so before/after screenshots are not required.
No dependency, build script, workflow, or process file changed.
No review evidence was committed.

Requested before merge: none.
